message: '{0}' is a local function, so it cannot be invoked on an instance or a type.
title: Cannot invoke a local function on an instance or a type.
rationale: The message capitalizes 'Cannot' in the middle of a sentence and does not quote the placeholder. 'With a non-null instance' is imprecise: MethodInvoker.InvokeDefaultMethod (MethodInvoker.cs:175-180) reports the error whenever the receiver syntax is not the null literal, which includes a type name for static local functions and the implicit 'this' receiver.
engineBug: Suspected: MethodInvoker.cs:175-180 requires the receiver to be a null literal, but when no target is given, Invoker.GetReceiverInfo (Invoker.cs:123-139) produces a 'this' or type receiver, so invoking a local function with the default target always throws LAMA0018. Code generated by a template is never in the scope of a local function of the source code, so the invocation could never produce valid code anyway; the check is effectively a blanket rejection with a misleading reason. No Metalama test covers this report site.
